bannerText1: Play the main quest to collect Memsparks!
bannerText2:
1. Play the main quest (Window Into Memory) to collect Memsparks.
2. Puella Pictura are gradually unlocked as you collect set amounts of Memsparks.
3. Unlocking Puella Pictura will raise your Puella Pictura rank.
4. Raise your rank to get a variety of rewards, such as Magia Keys.

bannerText1: Collect Memsparks to complete Puella Pictura!
bannerText2:
1. Collect all matching Memsparks to complete a Puella Pictura.
2. When you complete a Puella Pictura, it will unlock some of the Nameless Girl's memory.
3. Complete a Puella Pictura again to get Magica Stone x1,000 and a Puella Pictura portrait.

bannerText1: Play the Puella Magi Madoka Magica main quest!
bannerText2:
1. You can get the 5★ Kioku "[Lux☆Magica] Madoka Kaname" by completing Puella Pictura in the Puella Magi Madoka Magica main quest.
2. Complete all the Puella Pictura in Puella Magi Madoka Magica to get a total of three copies of 5★ Kioku "[Lux☆Magica] Madoka Kaname."

bannerText1: Get 5★ Kioku from beginner missions!
bannerText2:
1. Clear the beginner missions to get another two copies of "5★ Kioku [Lux☆Magica] Madoka Kaname."
2. Once you obtain all 5★ Kioku "[Lux☆Magica] Madoka Kaname," you can fully ascend the Kioku to boost its power significantly.
